Companion.BindHint: Pick the companion's actor (it must exist in the Actors directory) and how it is paid. Companion.ControllerIntro: Bring out your companion, send it away, command it and use its actions. It appears next to your hero's token; drag it where you want.
Companion.ControllerNotes: Manifest spends one slot (or what the GM set). Recall and Return spend nothing. Dismiss ends it: the next Manifest needs a new slot. One command per round is tracked in combat.

HP.vestige: Vestige Companion: 4 + 4 × Warlock level, full on every manifestation

Death.Cleared: Visible counters cleared (the secret tally is unchanged)
Death.ConfigHint: These settings and results live in the GM journal, not on the player's actor.
Death.ConfirmClear: Clear the VISIBLE death save counters of {name}? The secret tally stays.
Death.ConfirmReset: Reset the secret death saves of {name}?
Death.Intro: For characters (and NPCs if you turn it on). World options are in the module settings; each actor's bonus, advantage and auto-roll are here. The running tally is never put on the actor: it is kept in a GM-only journal. Only the final result is announced. Never give players access to that journal.
Death.NativeBlocked: Blind Death Saves: roll from the Planar Homebrew manager (Death saves). The sheet's death save roll is off.
Death.NoEffects: death save bonuses and advantage from Active Effects (Bless, items) are NOT read into these rolls; set them here. Turn off other death save automation.
Death.Notes: Secret roll rolls the next save. Automatic rolls happen when a downed hero's turn starts (the main GM must be connected). Use +1 / +2 failures for damage at 0 HP (failures the system puts on the sheet are moved here by themselves). Reset after special healing or a correction; Clear visible counters removes counters already on the sheet.
Death.Off: Blind Death Saves are turned off in the module settings
Death.PrivateFailure: GM ruling: {name} takes {amount} death save failure(s). Secret tally: {successes} successes / {failures} failures.

Companion.Hint: A world actor bound to a hero as a familiar or vestige: manifest by casting, recall, return, command.
Companion.Manager: bind any actor to a hero. Manifest spends one slot the player picks (or casts a spell, or is free) and places the token next to the hero; players do it from the companion window or the Token HUD.
Companion.Name: Bound Companion

Death.Hint: The GM rolls death saves in secret; only stable, dead or back on their feet is announced.
Death.Manager: heroes at 0 HP roll death saves in secret, by the GM. Successes and failures live in a GM-only journal; the sheet's own death save button is blocked; only the final result is announced. A death is handed to Planar Glitch when it is active.
Death.Name: Blind Death Saves

Light.Hint: An inventory item that lights the holder's token, counting ignitions and burn time.
Light.Manager: set up single items, or give the standard torches, candles and lanterns their profile in one go. Players light them from the light window or the item's Utility activity; ignitions and world time are tracked. In the light window, the Token lights tab gives any token (the vestige too) a ready-made light, and Scene lights switches, restores and softens every light.
Light.Name: Portable Light Source

Resonance.Hint: If the weapon's two damage dice match, roll another die and keep going while it matches; the first die that differs still counts. The weapon's own dice are not doubled on a critical hit.
Resonance.Manager: assign it to a weapon. The damage roll of its Attack activity chains automatically when the two weapon dice match (2d6, or the doubled 4d6 on a critical). Other damage parts, such as a smite, are left alone.
Resonance.Name: Silver Eagle Resonance

TokenLight.Intro: Give any token a light (the vestige's aura, a magical glow…). Pick the token (or right-click it on the map → light bulb), choose the light, Apply. Players can't do this: they light what their heroes carry.

TokenLight.NoTokens: You own no token on this scene.

TokenLight.NoSources: No light sources on this scene.
